scope: Proposition 7.4 (Pseudoeffective domination variant) of the manuscript “Cohomological transfer and equivariant anticanonical sections” (preprints/Cohomological-transfer-and-equivariant-anticanonical-sections-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e231fa726d0f6b6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In Theorem 7.2, replace the kernel hypothesis by the assumption that bDV − f∗H is pseudoeffective for some b > 0 and some ample line H on Y . Then the same vanishing holds.
